inputs.text:
Folks, you simply cannot make this up. Look at the absolute wreckage left behind by years of progressive mismanagement in our public systems. Instead of sticking to the bedrock principles of education, discipline, and basic fiscal common sense, our schools are collapsing under bloated bureaucracies and completely misplaced priorities. 

Just look at what is happening in the South Portland School District. A parent was actually forced to step up and publicly apologize to the educators and staff over a massive budget shortfall that is going to slash over 70 positions from our schools. This is the inevitable harvest when traditional values and accountable governance are tossed aside for endless spending and administrative bloat. 

Our children and hardworking taxpayers are the ones left holding the bag, forced to pay the price for these recurring budget crises while the core mission of education gets completely gutted. It is high time we restore order, demand personal responsibility from local leaders, and stop treating our schools as slush funds for failed progressive agendas.
